regime_context: The detector shows a strong, concentrated AI semiconductor leadership cluster (AI Infrastructure, Memory/HBM, WFE, AI Semiconductors all top-5, all eligible) with healthy breadth and no crowding flags on the leaders; momentum focus lens is displayed as validated only for drawdown/trend-gate risk control, not return forecasting. Breadth of rotation is 'narrowing' and absorption is low, so the regime read is steady concentration rather than a one-narrative melt-up; the track record (dir_accuracy 0.488 across 84 calls) says directional precision is weak, so conviction stays low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Memory, HBM & Storage closes the rotation margin versus AI Infrastructure (currently 0.422) to within 0.10 on a sustained basis — that would suggest a confirmed leadership handoff within the semiconductor complex, retiring the AI Infrastructure leader assumption only if Memory simultaneously holds breadth above 0.70 for five consecutive sessions.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the clear leader (rank 1, score 2.295) with the highest durability_bar (0.71) and strong breadth (0.875), and it is eligible with the absolute-trend gate true. The trend-gate leg — the only validated risk-control feature — says this theme is in a staying-power regime worth retaining a lean toward, not chasing for return. Crowding is absent (crowding_z 0.84, crowded false), so no size-down caution applies; this is a keep-the-lean call, not a buy-the-rank call.
theses.dissent: As the narrative leader, AI Infrastructure is the natural top-tick candidate if thematic attention spikes — inflows/attention spikes mark tops, and its val_state is 'fading' in the headline, which could presage churn even while rank stays high.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM is the designated challenger to AI Infrastructure (rotation margin 0.422) with a trend tag and solid durability_bar (0.72) and breadth (0.75), eligible under the trend gate. It is the only top-5 name with hurst_tag 'trend' and no crowding z above 1, which supports a modest persistence lean in the same semiconductor complex.
theses.dissent: The theme shares the SMH proxy with the rest of the semiconductor cluster, so it is not differentiated alpha — if the AI hardware complex pulls back, Memory/HBM gives no diversifying help and the detector's 'narrowing' rotation breadth means few other places to hide.

falsifier.text: SMH underperforms SPY by more than 3% over any rolling 10-day window before 2026-10-31

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity has the strongest trend tag (hurst_tag 'trend'), perfect breadth (1.0), and the highest durability_bar (0.83), but it is the only crowded name in the top tier (crowding_z 1.97, crowded true). Guardrails forbid treating crowding as a short or sell — only as a size-down caution. As a directional lean, the crowded flag plus the attention-spike-topping guidance argues for not adding exposure here, hence an 'avoid' lean on this theme rather than a fade.
evidence: crowding_z 1.97, crowded true (only top-5 crowded name)
guardrails: crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade
theses.dissent: Perfect breadth and a strong trend tag with no sign of breaking mean the top-attention concern may be premature — avoiding a clean-trend winner while the semiconductor complex stays strong could just mean missing the least-crowded-topic rally in the sector.
